entries.notes: The original manifest spells 秘. The complete 0705 video, inspected at 0.5-second intervals and in its enlarged completed frame, draws 示 in five strokes (two horizontal strokes, vertical, left dot, right dot), followed by 必 in five strokes. It therefore supplies visual evidence for 祕, not the 禾 form named by the manifest. This is a row-specific observation, not a general equivalence of 秘 and 祕. Candidate geometry still requires a separate completed whole-glyph review.

The original publisher manifest labels row 0402 as 凉. The complete video sampled at 0.5-second intervals and its enlarged completed frame at 10.8 seconds draw the three strokes of 氵 (upper dot, middle dot, rising stroke), followed by 京 in eight strokes, supplying visual evidence for 涼. This is an exact row/video observation, not a general equivalence of 凉 and 涼. Geometry and all stroke boundaries still require a separate whole-glyph review.

The original publisher manifest labels row 1799 as 戱. The complete video sampled at 0.5-second intervals and its enlarged completed frame at 21.8 seconds draw 虍 with 豆 beneath it, followed by 戈, supplying visual evidence for the seventeen-stroke 戲. This is an exact row/video observation, not a general equivalence of 戱 and 戲. Geometry and all stroke boundaries still require a separate whole-glyph review.
